newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen up as demand outpaces supply.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen up as demand outpaces supply.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks are seen opening firm and moving up as demand outstrips supply, brokers said.
"There is foreign and local demand for an increasing number of stocks, but there is little supply," said Dihan Dedigama of John Keells Stock Brokers.
Brokers say demand for stocks has risen after analysts upgraded growth forecasts for the accounting years ending on December 31, 1997 and March 31, 1998.
"With an upward revision of EPS forecasts, many stocks look attractive even at current price levels which have risen sharply so far this year," said one.
On Monday the all share index closed 2.6 points up at 741.9, on turnover of 16.3 million rupees.
"Turnover should be higher today since we have some big foreign buy orders from Hongkong, which was on holiday on Monday," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
